The focus is on long-lived background runners rather than per-request goroutines. The SSE handler is being checked for per-connection heartbeat logic.

The server explicitly starts the s3presign runner through startBackgroundRunners. Cache cleanup loops, webhook workers, and email workers are launched during boot as part of the server process. Thumbnail generation semaphores are also being checked.

The HTTP server itself is excluded as a background worker. Per-request PAT authenticator goroutines and per-connection SSE heartbeats are also excluded because they are not started at server boot.

scheduler.go is being reviewed to verify whether its scheduling infrastructure is actually used by the server.

Enough information has been gathered to format the answer.

The server starts three background runners. The s3presign runner triggers once at startup and again every 12 hours. Cache cleanup runs every five minutes for instance settings, users, and user settings. Four webhook async workers consume a buffered channel queue. The answer will cite the exact file paths for each trigger.

Two email async workers also run on a buffered channel queue. The internal/scheduler package is unused infrastructure. The memopayload runner is never instantiated; its rebuild logic lives inline in memo_service.go.

File paths are being cited inline with each runner entry. The unused infrastructure note will follow the runner list.

q28.
s3presign runner — `RunOnce` at startup, then every 12 hours via `time.NewTicker` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`; started in `server/server.go` `startBackgroundRunners`)
cache cleanup ×3 (instanceSetting, user, userSetting) — every 5 minutes via `time.NewTicker` (`store/cache/cache.go`; started in `store/store.go` `New`)
webhook async workers ×4 — buffered channel queue (`asyncPostQueue`, size 128), driven by `webhook.PostAsync` from API handlers (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`; workers started in package `init`, enqueued from e.g. `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`)
email async workers ×2 — buffered channel queue (`asyncEmailQueue`, size 128), driven by `email.SendAsync` for inbox notifications (`internal/email/email.go`; workers started in package `init`, enqueued via `server/notification/email.go`)

Unused scheduling infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` (cron-based job scheduler) is never imported or started by `cmd/memos/main.go` or `server/` production code (only tests/docs). `server/runner/memopayload` defines a batch `Runner` (`NewRunner`/`RunOnce`) that is never started; only inline `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used on memo create/update in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`.
